title: Parrot First-Half 2026 Results
excerpt: H1 revenue was EUR 57.3 million, professional microdrone revenue rose 23%, gross margin was 51.8%, and recurring operating income was EUR 2.0 million.
summary: The issuer's first-half release supplies current revenue mix, growth, margins, earnings, cash flow, liquidity, balance-sheet, partnership, award and outlook evidence for Parrot's full assessment.
